name: table
description: One native, editable table filling the content well: `columns` names the column heads (bold header row), `rows` is an array of cell arrays, optional `note` sits bottom-right. The table NEVER splits across slides — keep to about 12 body rows and summarize the rest.

columns.description: column head strings; one per column

rows.description: one array of cell strings per body row, in column order

note.description: optional footnote under the table (data period, sampling, caveat)
